segments.name: Peak Gold, JV
segments.description: Equity interest in the Peak Gold JV, which operates the Manh Choh mines in Alaska and recognizes its operating income or loss.
segments.evidence: The Peak Gold JV, engages in business activities from which the Company recognizes operating income or loss.

segments.name: Exploration
segments.description: Exploration and development of gold ore and associated minerals in Alaska, including the Johnson Tract and Lucky Shot projects.
segments.evidence: The Company's CODM reviews the quarterly results of the Company's exploration projects based on the expenditures associated with the exploration in the regions where the Company's mineral claims are located.

revenueModel.text: The Company receives cash distributions from the Peak Gold JV, which pays out from its gold production at Manh Choh.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company received $102.0 million in cash distributions from the Peak Gold JV during fiscal 2025 related to production at Manh Choh.
